content.value_statement: Internal updates often need clear structure, consistent tone, and audience-specific detail. This skill provides formats for newsletters, 3P updates, FAQs, and leadership messages.
actual_capabilities: Drafts 3P updates with progress, plans, and problems sections.
Creates company newsletter outlines and bullet-style updates.
Formats FAQ responses for internal audiences.
Adapts tone and structure for leadership, project, and incident updates.
Asks for clarification when the communication type is unclear.
limitations: It does not verify facts without user-provided sources or authorized tools.
It does not decide what confidential information may be shared.
It does not publish messages to Slack, email, or other channels.
It may need company-specific style rules for exact brand alignment.

use_cases.title: Prepare Weekly Team Updates
use_cases.description: Turn raw team notes into a clear 3P update with progress, plans, and problems.

use_cases.title: Draft Company Newsletters
use_cases.description: Summarize major announcements, milestones, and leadership messages for a broad employee audience.

use_cases.title: Answer Common Employee Questions
use_cases.description: Create concise FAQ responses that explain policy, project, or process changes.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a short internal update from these notes. Use clear bullets, a direct tone, and a brief closing action.

prompt_templates.title: Create a 3P Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 3P update for this team. Separate progress, plans, and problems. Highlight blockers and owner actions.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Company Newsletter
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a company newsletter from these approved sources. Group items by theme and keep each bullet concise.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an Executive Message
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this leadership update for a company-wide audience. Preserve facts, reduce ambiguity, and flag claims that need verification.

output_examples.input: Notes about shipped features, hiring progress, and one blocked dependency.
output_examples.output: A 3P update with completed work, next plans, and one clearly marked problem with an owner.

output_examples.input: Approved links and notes from the past week of company announcements.
output_examples.output: A newsletter draft with sections for announcements, priorities, leadership updates, and social highlights.

output_examples.input: Employee questions about a new internal process.
output_examples.output: A concise FAQ with direct answers, escalation points, and items that need policy confirmation.

best_practices: Provide source notes, audience, channel, and desired length before drafting.
Mark confidential or restricted information before asking for a summary.
Review all facts, links, and names before sending the final message.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent announcements or executive positions.
Do not include private Slack, email, or document links without approval.
Do not use one message format for every audience or channel.

faq.question: What kinds of internal communications does this support?
faq.answer: It supports 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.

faq.question: Can it write from raw notes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize rough notes into a clear internal message when the audience and purpose are provided.

faq.question: Does it access Slack or email by itself?
faq.answer: No. It can use authorized tools only when the host environment provides them and the user permits access.

faq.question: Can it handle confidential information?
faq.answer: It can help rewrite sensitive content, but users must define what may be shared and who may receive it.

faq.question: Does it publish messages automatically?
faq.answer: No. It drafts and formats content, but users should review and send messages through approved channels.
